_comment: Seam warp pairs that REPLACE a pokeemerald map CONNECTION with a synthetic two-cell direction-gated ARROW-WARP pair (MB_NORTH/SOUTH/EAST/WEST_ARROW_WARP). Used ONLY when the two maps cannot share a tileset: their unique-8x8-tile union exceeds the hard 1024-tile cap and both metatile dedup and unreferenced-metatile pruning are measured-exhausted. This is a user-approved fidelity substitution (loses cross-map scroll-stitching at this one seam), not a general connection replacement — most seams stay real connections. Schema: cells_a[i] pairs 1:1 with cells_b[i] (reciprocal warp cells, geometry-verified passable + connection-offset-consistent). direction_a/direction_b name the arrow direction (up/down/left/right = the travel direction that fires the warp) each side's cells carry; see rpg2gba.tileset_converter.seam_warps. NOTE 2026-10-06: the one seam this file carried (kevlar_town_route_02, maps 31<->35) was retired when 31+35 moved onto a shared synthetic tileset (map_set.tileset_groups), so that seam is a real scrolling connection again; the mechanism stays for any future seam whose maps cannot share a tileset.
